So good we came back twice - Authentic Flavours, Atmosphere, Service
Jun 2026 • Couples
This is more than a restaurant, it is an experience - the food is memorable - full of fresh flavour at an inexpensive price. The staff are friendly and efficient, wearing colourful local costumes. We loved it so much we went back twice. We tried the steamboat Beef for 2 persons 550,000k - such great value for dinner. At lunch we also tried sizzling pork and a chicken curry dish, with a side dish of roasted fried sweet potatoe. It is not just a beautiful restaurant it is also mouthwateringly delicious with wonderful customer service.
Insider tip:
Located near the Pistacio Hotel end of SAPA
